elements.content: Right now, at school, many things are happening. In the classroom, students are listening to the teacher. The teacher is explaining math problems on the blackboard. Some students are raising their hands to ask questions. In the art room, students are painting and drawing. They are using bright colors to make beautiful pictures. In the library, a group of students are reading books quietly. On the playground, some kids are playing soccer, while others are jumping rope. In the school garden, a few students are planting flowers, watering them carefully. Everyone at school is busy and enjoying their activities.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello
child_list.name: 题目

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

child_list.content: 在学校
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 此刻，学校里正发生着许多事。在教室里，学生们正在听老师讲课。老师正在黑板上解释数学题。一些学生举手提问。在美术室里，学生们正在画画。他们用鲜艳的色彩绘制美丽的图画。在图书馆里，一群学生正在安静地读书。在操场上，一些孩子在踢足球，而另一些则在跳绳。在学校的花园里，几名学生正在种花，并仔细地给它们浇水。学校里的每个人都很忙碌，享受着各自的活动。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
